nodes.text: Sit, if you like. The road was here before the towns, and the Company was here before the wardens. What do you want?

choices.text: What do you buy and sell?

nodes.text: Ferrick. I keep the Company's ledger for this stretch. Two columns, no headings: people who are useful, and people who owe. You get to pick your column.
A tollhouse. The bar goes up for friends of the road and down for everyone else. The wardens hang lamps and call the road theirs. Lamps burn out. A debt doesn't.
Buying, and buying back. The Company's ledger runs both directions. Whatever arrives in your pack with a history stays off the page.
